module.purpose: Provides a one-use coordination helper that delays export completion until registered asynchronous work settles or a maximum delay expires.
module.summary: This module defines a helper object for export workflows. Callers register promises during rendering, and resolution waits for all currently registered work plus promises added during subsequent event-loop cycles. Each rejection is logged and treated as settled, while a configured timeout prevents indefinite waiting. After resolution completes, further registrations are rejected.
module.businessContext: Supports reliable editor exports by allowing asynchronous rendering or asset preparation to finish before output generation. Failure can produce incomplete or inconsistent exported documents, while excessive waiting delays the user-facing export.
classes: ExportDelay (~L9-49): Coordinates asynchronous export waits before export completion.
functions: constructor (~L13-13): Stores the maximum delay allowed for export coordination.
waitUntil (~L15-25): Registers an asynchronous operation required before export resolution.
resolvePromises (~L27-36): Waits through dynamically expanding batches of registered promises.
resolve (~L38-48): Races promise completion against the configured export timeout.

io: Logs rejected registered promises with console.error.
process: Schedules asynchronous delays through imported sleep calls.

units.name: ExportDelay

detail.name: ExportDelay
detail.summary: ExportDelay coordinates asynchronous export-related work and completes once tracked promises settle or the configured maximum delay is reached. It prevents additional promises from being registered after resolution.

units.name: waitUntil

detail.name: waitUntil
preconditions: The export must not already be resolved.
The promise argument must be a promise-like value supporting catch().
postconditions: When unresolved, the promise returned by promise.catch(...) is appended to promisesToWaitFor.
A rejection from the supplied promise is converted into a fulfilled promise after being logged.
invariants: Once isResolved is true, no additional promise is appended.
Registered promise rejections are handled by logging rather than being propagated through the promise stored for resolution.
edgeCases: If isResolved is true, the method throws synchronously and does not register the promise.
If the supplied promise rejects, console.error is called with the fixed prefix and rejection value, and the rejection is swallowed by the catch handler.
If the supplied promise fulfills, it is registered without error logging.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Throws when called after the export has already been resolved.

stateMutations: Appends the promise returned by promise.catch(...) to this.promisesToWaitFor when this.isResolved is false.

units.name: resolvePromises

detail.name: resolvePromises
preconditions: this.promisesToWaitFor is accessible and has a length property.
The sleep dependency is callable with a zero-millisecond delay.
postconditions: All promises present in this.promisesToWaitFor during the final settlement pass have settled.
The method resolves only after the tracked promise-list length remains unchanged across a settlement pass and a subsequent event-loop cycle.
Rejections from tracked promises do not cause this method itself to reject.
invariants: Promise settlement is performed with Promise.allSettled rather than fail-fast aggregation.
The method rechecks the tracked promise-list length after yielding to the event loop.
edgeCases: When the tracked promise list is initially empty, one all-settled pass and one zero-delay event-loop yield occur before the method resolves.
If tracked promises add more promises while settling or during the event-loop yield, the newly increased length causes another settlement cycle.
If a tracked promise rejects, its rejection is observed by allSettled and processing continues.
If promises continue adding entries on every cycle, the method continues waiting until the length stabilizes.
detail.summary: Waits for all currently tracked promises to settle and continues until a complete event-loop cycle produces no newly tracked promises.

specLiterals.role: Requests a zero-delay sleep to yield for one event-loop cycle before checking for newly added promises.

specTests.then: The method waits for that promise to settle and resolves without propagating the promise rejection.
The method performs a subsequent settlement cycle that includes the newly added promise before resolving.

units.name: resolve

detail.name: resolve
preconditions: The instance has a configured maxDelayTimeMs value.
postconditions: When the race settles successfully, isResolved is set to true.
If the timeout settles first, console.warn is called with the timeout warning literal.
invariants: Completion is determined by the first settlement of the timeout promise and resolvePromises().
The method does not set isResolved until the Promise.race has settled.
edgeCases: If resolvePromises() settles before the timeout, the method completes without issuing the timeout warning.
If the timeout settles first, the method issues the timeout warning and then marks the instance resolved.
If the raced promise rejects, the rejection propagates and the subsequent isResolved assignment is not performed.

raises: Propagates rejection from the raced promise.

stateMutations: Sets this.isResolved to true after successful Promise.race completion.
eventsEmitted: Writes a timeout warning through console.warn when the timeout wins.
detail.summary: Waits for either the configured maximum delay or the pending resolution work to complete. It marks the export delay as resolved after the race completes and warns when the timeout wins.

specLiterals.role: Exact warning text emitted when the timeout promise wins.
